svg.text: How the data moves through the t12 pipeline
from the csvs the LLM wrote to the star schema in MotherDuck, with what each step does to the table
20 csvs per table, one per pet
dates parsed, HH:MM clock times → timestamps
one row per case, + age and weight from patients
+ counts of meds, labs, procedures, staff, remarks
times → timestamps on the case date
remark_time → timestamp on the case date
tags in the top right name the function that builds the table
